text: It is a very good app: it has a friendly UI, habit tracking and it is connectable to Google. The only downside is lack of measurability: you can only set 0-1 goals, hence you cannot monitor, e.g., how long you are sleeping.
author: Piotr C. Sosnowski
developer_reply: Thank you for your detailed feedback! We’re glad to hear you enjoy the friendly UI, habit tracking, and Google integration. We understand the importance of measurability and will definitely consider adding more customizable goals in future updates to allow tracking of things. Your input is invaluable to us—thanks for helping us improve!
